newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat 1996 net profit 2.371 trillion lire.
newsitem.headline: Fiat 1996 net profit 2.371 trillion lire.

text.p: Italy's industrial giant Fiat SpA on Thursday reported a 1996 net profit of 2.371 trillion lire ($1.4 billion) against 1995's 2.147 trillion, and declared a 1996 ordinary dividend of 100 lire/share after 1995's 100 lire/share payout.

The group said in a statement that in the first quarter of 1997 its pretax profit rose to 495 billion lire from 464 billion in the first quarter of 1996, but 1997 Q1 operating profits slipped to 450 billion lire from 504 billion lire.
Group consolidated debt slipped to 2.211 trillion lire at end-1996 from 2.597 trillion lire at end-1995.

First quarter 1997 group sales rose 4.4 percent to 20.844 trillion lire, while automotive unit Fiat Auto said it sold some 628,000 vehicles showing a rise of 3.7 percent from first quarter 1996 levels.

First quarter 1997 profitability of industrial sales was 514 billion lire after 545 billion lire, giving an operating margin of 2.6 percent for the first quarter, in line with 1996, Fiat said in a statement.
The 1996 net profit of the holding company Fiat SpA was 626 billion lire after 515 billion lire in 1995.
